jobs.title: Freelance Software Tester | Remote (Malaysia)
jobs.description: Do you have a Bank Muamalat bank account ? Would you like to earn extra income by helping improve digital payment experiences? We'd love to hear from you! About Testlio Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012. We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps us identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers. Learn more about us at www.testlio.com . We're looking for people in Malaysia to help test online payments for an international social media technology company. Requirements Location: Currently living in Malaysia Payment method: Have an existing, active Bank Muamalat bank account. Comfortable following written instructions and sharing feedback in English. Have access to a smartphone. Work type: Remote, freelance, and flexible. What You'll Do Follow simple, step-by-step instructions from our testing team. Complete small, authorized test purchases using your existing Bank Muamalat bank account. Check whether payments are successful or if any errors appear. Share your results, transaction confirmations and report any issues, including screenshots when needed. Guidance will be provided to protect your sensitive information. Why do we need local testers? Payment methods work differently from country to country. A transaction that works in one country might fail in another. That's why we need people who live locally and have access to the payment methods customers actually use. Your role is to help us check whether payments work correctly and report any issues you find. No previous software testing experience is required. Privacy & Security We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously. You'll only be asked to complete authorized testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive account information in your reports. Interested in joining us? Apply through our official Testlio Work Opportunities page . If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps. All official email communications will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox! #LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Quality Engineer (Automation JS/TS) - Software Industry
jobs.description: Headquarters: LatAm About Truelogic At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals. Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference. By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future. Our Client A leading loyalty and customer engagement company that helps major brands create meaningful customer experiences through data-driven strategies, technology, and end-to-end loyalty solutions. With over two decades of industry experience, the company partners with well-known brands to strengthen customer relationships and drive long-term engagement. Job Summary We are looking for a technically strong QA Engineer to join our client's engineering team and help enhance its quality assurance practices. This role focuses on backend and API testing , database validation, and the development of scalable, reusable test automation frameworks. The ideal candidate combines solid software testing fundamentals with hands-on automation experience using Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript , strong debugging skills, and the ability to independently investigate complex backend issues. This position also embraces AI-driven development workflows. You will actively use tools such as Claude AI, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding assistants to accelerate test development, improve automation frameworks, identify edge cases, debug failures, and reduce repetitive manual testing. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining QA engineering expertise with modern AI-assisted development practices. Responsibilities Design and execute backend, API, integration, functional, and regression tests, validating REST APIs, authentication flows, data integrity, and error handling. Perform database validation using SQL queries and troubleshoot backend defects through application logs, network traces, API responses, and database records. Build and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable tools. Leverage AI coding assistants such as Claude AI or Claude Code to accelerate test development, generate edge cases, debug failures, and improve automation workflows. Maintain reusable automation components, AI context files, and prompt instructions to ensure consistent and maintainable test practices. Collaborate with Engineering and DevOps teams to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, and stability. Qualifications and Job Requirements Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance, with a strong focus on backend/API testing and test automation. Test Automation: Proven experience building automation frameworks from scratch or extending existing test suites using Playwright with JavaScript or TypeScript. Strong experience with Cypress or WebdriverIO is also relevant, provided you are willing to transition to Playwright. AI-Assisted Development: Practical experience using Claude AI, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI-powered developer tools to write, refactor, debug, and maintain automation code. Backend & API Testing: Solid understanding of REST API architecture, HTTP protocols, JSON/XML formats, authentication mechanisms, and API validation. Database Testing: Working knowledge of relational databases and the ability to write SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, and data validation checks. Technical Debugging: Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, including experience with browser DevTools, API clients such as Postman or Insomnia, application logs, and Git version control. Automation Best Practices: Understanding of reusable test components, Page Object Model (POM), fixtures, shared utilities, and maintainable automation architecture. Ownership & Autonomy: Ability to independently design test strategies, investigate complex issues, take ownership of assigned features, and work with minimal supervision. Communication & Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with engineering and cross-functional teams. Nice to Have Experience testing high-volume retail or e-commerce applications, particularly checkout flows, inventory management, pricing engines, order management systems, or payment gateways. Experience creating and maintaining repos

jobs.description: About Vexcash AG VEXCASH AG is Germany’s leading online provider of short-term loans. Thanks to our innovative approach, they can secure financial liquidity without having to commit to a long-term arrangement. Your responsibilities Develop automated UI test scripts using C# and .NET. Create, maintain and improve automated testing frameworks. Implement Page Object Model (POM) design patterns to ensure reusable and maintainable test code. Develop and execute automated API tests for RESTful web services using C# and .NET. Perform API testing using Postman and automated testing frameworks. Validate API requests, responses, HTTP status codes, JSON payloads and data integrity. Use NUnit, xUnit or MSTest for automated test execution. Automate functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing. Integrate automated UI and API tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. Execute automated test suites and analyse test results. Collaborate with C#/.NET developers to investigate and resolve UI, API and application-related defects. Maintain test documentation, test cases and automation scripts. Benefits A responsible and varied position with a high level of autonomy The opportunity to actively shape and further develop our quality organization A collaborative and international working environment If you are motivated and excited about taking on this responsible role and becoming part of our success story, we encourage you to apply today!
